answer:
The American presidents who have brought the United States into the Paris Agreement are **Barack Obama** (who originally signed the agreement in 2015-2016) and **Joe Biden** (who re-joined the agreement in 2021). 

Both Presidents belong to the **Democratic Party**:

- **Barack Obama** - Democrat - Signed the Paris Agreement in September 2015/December 2015, bringing the U.S. formally into the agreement on November 4, 2016, when it came into effect.

- **Joe Biden** - Democrat - Re-signed/rejoined the Paris Agreement on January 20, 2021 (Inauguration Day), with formal re-entry occurring on February 19, 2021.

Notably, President Donald Trump (Republican) had withdrawn the U.S. from the Paris Agreement in 2020, which Biden reversed upon taking office. So regardless of whether you're referring to the original entry (Obama) or the re-entry (Biden), the political party is the same: **Democratic Party**.
